scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mypi/protocol build && pnpm --filter @mypi/web build && pnpm --filter @mypi/server build
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm --filter @mypi/protocol build && pnpm --filter @mypi/server build && pnpm --filter @mypi/desktop build && pnpm --parallel --filter @mypi/web --filter @mypi/desktop dev
scripts.desktop:pack: pnpm build && tsx scripts/bundle-pi.ts && pnpm --filter @mypi/desktop pack
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: pnpm build && tsx scripts/bundle-pi.ts && pnpm --filter @mypi/desktop pack:mac
scripts.desktop:pack:win: pnpm build && tsx scripts/bundle-pi.ts && pnpm --filter @mypi/desktop pack:win
